description: Contract for the agentBrain interactive prompt layer (prompt-helper.sh). All first-party installer and onboarding questions must be expressible in this spec. A question = type + title + options + orientation (default/required) + view style.

functions.multi: ab_prompt_multi — checkbox list, one or more choices
functions.text: ab_prompt_text — free-form input (planned, not yet implemented)

flags: --layout vertical|inline (per question; global default via AB_PROMPT_LAYOUT, default vertical)

view_styles.numbered: ▸ 1) keep — present and fine · default row suffixed '(default)'
view_styles.plain: ▸ keep — present and fine · no numbers, narrow terminals
view_styles.vertical: ▸ 1) Yes / ▸ 2) No as numbered rows (confirm default)

guarantees: no external dependencies: bash 3.2+ and a tty only
first key read blocks; a timeout can never be interpreted as Enter
menu block redraws strictly in place with a fixed line count
terminal state always restored, also on Ctrl-C
a lone ESC followed quickly by another key never swallows that key (replay buffer)
known limitation: a lone ESC immediately followed (<1s) by arrow keys may misparse; the keys are replayed safely and never select the wrong row — press Esc and arrows separately

env.AB_PROMPT_DEBUG: when set: append key/decision trace to this file
env.AB_PROMPT_HELPER_STANDALONE: set to 1 to run the helper as a CLI (select|multi|confirm); required because the helper is embedded into standalone installers
env.AB_PROMPT_LAYOUT: global question layout: vertical (default) or inline
